basic_details.short_information: One Teaching Associate post in the Department of Agronomy is to be filled through a walk-in interview at Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College, Udayagiri, a college of Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), on 12 November 2026 from 11.00 AM. No application is sent in advance: candidates must register their names before 10.00 AM that day at the Office of Associate Dean of the college, with the filled-in application form and their certificates. The post is purely temporary and contractual, for a period not exceeding 11 months.

Udayagiri on 12 November 2026 from 11.00 AM. The decision of the selection committee for the position will be final and binding in all respects. Selected candidates will be required to undergo a medical examination at their own expense

important_instructions: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual for a period not exceeding 11 months, and ends automatically after 11 months or on the filling of regular staff by the university, whichever is earlier. The incumbent shall have no claim to any regular appointment in the university or any government organisation. The incumbent shall have no claim to further continuation of contractual service. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification at the time of selection, or termination even during the contractual engagement period. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason. The engaged person may leave the contractual service by giving one month's notice; otherwise one month's salary is to be paid before leaving. No T.A & D.A will be given to candidates appearing for the interview. The Associate Dean of the college has a right to cancel or postpone the interview for the said date due to any unavoidable circumstances.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting College
content_sections.text: Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College is a college of Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University, located at Udayagiri, SPSR Nellore (Dt.) - 524 226. The walk-in interview is conducted by the Associate Dean of the college, and the post sits in the college's Department of Agronomy.

content_sections.heading: Walk-in Venue and How to Register
content_sections.text: There is no postal or email application for this post. Candidates must report in person on 12 November 2026 as follows: Fill in the application form printed with the notice (pages 3 and 4 of the PDF). Reach the Office of Associate Dean, Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College, Udayagiri, SPSR Nellore (Dt.) - 524 226. Register your name before 10.00 AM on 12 November 2026. Hand in the filled-in application with all original certificates and one set of photocopies of all certificates, publications and any other relevant documents. Attend the walk-in interview, which begins at 11.00 AM at SMGR Agricultural College, Udayagiri. Name, date of birth and age as on the date of the walk-in interview, and social category. Educational qualifications (Ph.D., Masters, Under Graduation, any other) with year of passing, OGPA, and college and university. Experience in chronological order from the latest: dates, name of the position, organisation and pay details. Publications: total research papers, and the number in NAAS rated/Scopus indexed/Web of Science/UGC CARE listed journals; books and book chapters. Number of conferences, seminars, symposia and workshops attended, and number of trainings attended (with details enclosed). Contact details (full postal address, e-mail, mobile number, parents' details and contact), a signed declaration accepting the terms and conditions, and the candidate's signature with date.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice is for one post: Teaching Associate (01 No.) in the Department of Agronomy, purely temporary and on a contractual basis, not exceeding a period of 11 months. The notice lists the essential qualifications as printed below: a) Ph.D. in the relevant subject or b) Master's Degree in relevant subject c) Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years having first division or equivalent overall grade point average d) Experience for at least 3 years of respective teaching/ research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/ Associate ship/ Training/ other engagements. e) Published One research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/ NAAS rated ≥ 4.0 journals. f) Candidates having Post Graduate degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have the NET qualification. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification. The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. The application form asks for the candidate's age as on the date of the walk-in interview. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. HRA is paid on top of the remuneration, as per the existing State Government rates applicable in various places/locations, and is subject to change from time to time as per Government orders.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled-in application form (format printed with the notice) All original certificates One set of photocopies of all certificates Publications Any other relevant documents Details of trainings attended (the form asks for these to be enclosed)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the walk-in interview held at SMGR Agricultural College, Udayagiri on 12 November 2026 from 11.00 AM. The decision of the selection committee for the position will be final and binding in all respects. Selected candidates will be required to undergo a medical examination at their own expense, as per the rules, to ensure physical fitness before appointment.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual for a period not exceeding 11 months, and ends automatically after 11 months or on the filling of regular staff by the university, whichever is earlier. The incumbent shall have no claim to any regular appointment in the university or any government organisation. The incumbent shall have no claim to further continuation of contractual service. Concealing facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification at the time of selection, or termination even during the contractual engagement period. Contractual engagements can be terminated at any time without prior notice or assigning any reason. The engaged person may leave the contractual service by giving one month's notice; otherwise one month's salary is to be paid before leaving. No T.A & D.A will be given to candidates appearing for the interview. The Associate Dean of the college has a right to cancel or postpone the interview for the said date due to any unavoidable circumstances.

faq.question: Q1. How many Teaching Associate vacancies has ANGRAU announced at SMGR Agricultural College, Udayagiri?
faq.answer: There is 1 Teaching Associate post, in the Department of Agronomy at Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College, Udayagiri.

faq.question: Q2. When is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026 from 11.00 AM at SMGR Agricultural College, Udayagiri; candidates must register their names before 10.00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: The notice lists Ph.D. in the relevant subject or Master's Degree in relevant subject, a Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years with first division or equivalent OGPA, at least 3 years of teaching/research experience, one research paper in SCI/NAAS rated ≥ 4.0 journals, and NET for PG holders in Basic Sciences with a 3-year Bachelor's and 2-year Master's degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women, and the application form asks for age as on the date of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an ANGRAU Teaching Associate?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 61,000/- per month plus applicable HRA for Master's Degree holders and Rs. 67,000/- per month plus applicable HRA for Ph.D. Degree holders.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the Teaching Associate remuneration?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is given in addition, as per the existing State Government rates applicable to the place, and is subject to change as per Government orders.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the ANGRAU Teaching Associate walk-in?
faq.answer: Register your name before 10.00 AM on 12 November 2026 at the Office of Associate Dean, Sri Mekapati Goutham Reddy Agricultural College, Udayagiri, with the filled-in application, all original certificates and one set of photocopies of certificates, publications and other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q8. How will the Teaching Associate be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through the walk-in interview, and the decision of the selection committee is final and binding; the selected candidate must undergo a medical examination at their own expense before appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ANGRAU Teaching Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is purely temporary and contractual for a period not exceeding 11 months, ending earlier if the regular post is filled, with no claim to regular appointment or continuation.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no T.A & D.A will be given to candidates appearing for the interview.
